canonical_name: No Integration of Supply Chain Risk Management into Cybersecurity and Enterprise Risk Management
description: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management is not integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of integration between supply chain risk management and broader cybersecurity or enterprise risk management programs. Check for lack of inclusion in risk assessment processes and continuous improvement activities.
